title: Beni Mellal city and foothills, 4 Jul to 16 Jul 2026
summary: From 4 Jul to 16 Jul 2026 the radar shows 1.32 km2 turning darker in HV around Beni Mellal, mostly on the changing fields. Mean HV over the 6 km circle fell by 0.19 dB.

sections.heading: What changed
sections.text: In 12 days, 0.36 km2 turned brighter by more than 3 dB in HV and 1.32 km2 darker. Mean HH moved by 0.03 dB, with 0.59 km2 brighter and 1.13 km2 darker in HH.

sections.heading: Where, by terrain type
sections.text: The changing fields had 0.92 km2 darker and 0.15 km2 brighter in HV, and their mean HV fell 0.74 dB. Rough dry ground and fields had 0.15 km2 darker. Built-up land fell 0.49 dB in HV, and trees, shrub and rugged slopes fell 0.07 dB.

sections.heading: Possible causes
sections.text: Possible cause for the darker fields: harvests in early July, which remove the plants that scatter HV; a field visit or harvest records would confirm it. Possible cause for the lower HV on built-up land: a small difference in viewing conditions; stable targets on more dates would check it.

sections.heading: Limits
sections.text: Neither date carries a flag. One track only, so slopes facing away from the radar can fall in shadow. Small patches are close to what speckle alone can produce at the 3 dB threshold.

sections.heading: What an agency could do next
sections.text: Match the darker field patches with the harvest calendar, and follow them on later dates to see when they are worked or sown again.
